## 3. MORITA EQUIVALENCE OF SUBRINGS FOR RINGS WITH LOCAL UNITS

When we refer to Morita equivalence in this paper, we are referring to the notion of Morita equivalence in rings with local units first developed by Abrams in [4] and further explored by Anh and Marki in [24]. We will denote Morita equivalent rings with local units R and S

A significant generalization of this section is removing the countability assumption used previously by being slightly more careful with our directed limits. This lets our results apply to all with local units instead of just rings with ơ-units; which will be useful later when we apply our results to objects that aren't necessarily countable rings
